access.query_inputs: query EEG (20 s) + both candidate envelopes (legal inputs)
access.readout_fit: target-cohort training people single-talker EEG + envelope pairs; no attention labels

foreign_map.rule: first query of a seeded permutation with the same content fold and another person (in-scope queries)

registry.data_access: external MindMix multimodal release (official training data; overlap with DTU/FAU not excluded by us); EEG branch only, no audio/CALRA tensor used
registry.input_support: 1 s container right-padded to the released 400-sample two-patch interface (patch 1 all zero); amplitude = loader z-score unchanged (MindMix per-window z-score not applied)
